'''Armaruk''' was a [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who served in the military of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

Amaruk had [[Armaruk's son|one son]], who was killed around [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="TOR" />
